quote: I want to become a Hunter just like my father.
There are liars who only lie when there's a reason to, and there are liars who also lie without reason.
I will become a Blacklist Hunter and bring down the Phantom Troupe.
Don't lump me in with you guys. I'm only in this for the money!
My greatest pleasure comes when such people buckle to their knees and beg for mercy.
I have no interest in any individual. The only thing I care about is the Troupe.
Why do humans insist on fighting over trivial differences, such as birthplace?
The king must not be harmed. That is our one absolute.
I've spent my entire life pushing myself to the limit to find a worthy opponent.
Killua, you are my little brother. I will always protect you from making wrong decisions.
Stress makes you stronger. That's the gift of Nen.
You should enjoy the little detours to the fullest. Because that's where you'll find the things more important than what you want.
There's no such thing as a painless lesson. That's how stupid humans are.
If you're going to cry, do it after the battle.
Hesitation at the crucial moment is a flaw you need to fix.
The Zoldycks have survived for generations because we never betray a client.
Professional assassins don't leave witnesses.
I was created to play games. But these games have rules, and rules must be respected.
Once I decided to play to win, I stopped worrying about the methods.
I only have fun when I'm being hated. People who aren't hated aren't worth a thing.
I am the Rookie Crusher. I take pride in making newbies fail the exam.
I have been training every single day since I was born. You think a kid like you can outlast a ninja?
My arrows are not just arrows. Each one is charged with a different kind of power.
My bees won't attack unless I'm in danger — but if I am, there's no stopping them.
I cannot fight a child. That is my code, and I will not break it.
By order of Chairman Netero, voting in the 13th Chairman election shall begin immediately.
Keeping pace with me is the first trial. Those who fall behind are unworthy of becoming Hunters.
A Hunter must be able to prepare and cook their own food in the wild. That is the essence of survival!
My single condition is this: bring me a whole roast pig — the most dangerous one in the forest.
Which hand is the coin in? Guess right three times in a row, and you may pass.
This is the Zoldyck estate. No visitors are allowed beyond this point.
You think a spinning top can't kill you? Let me show you otherwise.
My whips reach every corner of this ring. There is nowhere for you to run.
I'm not asking you to lose — I'm asking you to forfeit. There is a difference.
Our motto is simple — steal everything worth stealing, and destroy everything else.
I joined the Phantom Troupe for one reason only. To save my brother.
I can hear your heartbeat. You're frightened — but you are not lying.
I never wanted to be involved in this world. I just wanted to be with her.
My daughter's ability is what built this family. Without her gift, we are nothing.
Do not think of the enemy as human. Anyone who approaches the boss is to be neutralized. Understood?
One kiss is all it takes. After that, they will do anything I say.
Raging flames — burn them all to ash. Great Haiku of Fire!
I will not lift the curse without compensation. That is my one rule.
As long as Genthru gives the order, I will carry it out without question.
We are the Bombers. No one escapes once they have been marked.
Bring me more humans. My offspring must surpass every living thing that has ever existed.
If I cannot win, I will give you my life. That is the rule I live by for every match.
I will absorb your curse into myself. That is what I exist for.
I remember... I remember being Reina.
I have read every book the humans left behind. Knowledge is the greatest weapon of all.
I could end this in an instant if Silva-sama ordered it. Do not test me.
My grandmother and I have been assigned to escort you. Please do not make this any more difficult.
I don't have much to say. I'll just note that I'm confident I can supervise Beyond by myself.
